name: create undead
lore:
# Create Undead: The Shadow-Stitcher’s Rite

To cast this spell is to drag the Weave through a charnel pit. To the practitioner, the magic feels **oily and frigid**, like grasping a rusted chain submerged in stagnant water. It requires a heavy, rhythmic pull on the ley lines, forcing the ethereal to bind with the physical in a way that defies the Natural Order.

Visually, the manifestation is harrowing. Shadows do not merely fall; they thicken into **virid and umber threads** that knit themselves into the marrow of the deceased. There is no spark of soul-fire here—only a cold, pulsing luminescence that animates the meat and bone into a hateful mimicry of life.

**The Legend of Discovery**
It is whispered that **Malakor the Mournful** first unearthed this rite. Desperate to reclaim a fallen king, he realized that while the soul may flee, the "meat remembers its purpose." He did not return his sovereign to life; he merely taught the corpse to obey. Beware, seeker: to knit such tattered remains is to invite a chill into your own soul that no hearth-fire can ever truly warm.
